subject.title: Add configurable descriptive agent session labels

question: Should CodexBar add a persisted session-label preference that surfaces Codex thread titles and subagent names from Codex local state, while retaining project names as the default and fallback?
rationale: This is a new user-facing configuration mode and introduces an ongoing compatibility boundary with Codex internal state schema; code review alone cannot establish whether that product and maintenance tradeoff is desired.

options.title: Sponsor the configurable mode
options.body: Accept the preference and internal-state lookup after the contributor posts redacted runtime proof for descriptive labels and missing-metadata fallback.

options.title: Keep project-only labels
options.body: Decline the new persisted mode and retain the existing stable project-name behavior until Codex exposes supported title metadata.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the configurable mode
recommendation.body: Accept the preference and internal-state lookup after the contributor posts redacted runtime proof for descriptive labels and missing-metadata fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the repository’s menu UX and accepted dependency boundary for Codex local metadata.
